title: MandatePresetIndex
description: The catalogue of starting-point mandates in packages/schema/presets/. Exists so the genesis conversation and the dApp's preset cards read the SAME list: the model's recommendation and the button the user clicks cannot then diverge. Each entry points at a file that must itself validate as a Mandate — the conformance test enforces both that and the fact that this index matches the directory exactly, so a preset can never be listed-but-missing or present-but-unoffered.

version.description: Increments when an entry is added, removed or re-keyed.

key.description: Stable identifier, equal to the file's stem. Named after what the mandate does, never after a firm we do not speak for.

headline.description: One line for the card. What this mandate is for.

tradeoff.description: What the user gives up by choosing it. Required, not optional: a preset list where every option only has upsides is a menu that helps nobody choose, and the tradeoff is the part the genesis conversation should read aloud.

persona.description: Persona name carried by the preset, if any. Absent means the mandate ships neutral — useful as the control when comparing two personas on the same snapshot.
